seo__search_description: Oakdene House Foundation offers counselling, practical support, community programs and referral pathways for people experiencing hardship in Fairfield, Western Sydney.
hero__title: Addiction support that meets people where they are
hero__intro: Oakdene provides structured addiction support — counselling, group programs, peer meetings, and financial guidance — for people working through gambling, alcohol, and other dependencies. **Our team specialises in gambling and alcohol dependency, with experienced counsellors trained in these areas.**
what_we_offer__heading: Seven services across the recovery journey
what_we_offer__intro: From individual counselling to peer support and financial guidance — the full spectrum of addiction recovery in one place.
how_to_get_started__intro: Accessing support at Oakdene is straightforward. Here is what to expect.
who_we_support__heading: You don't need to meet specific criteria
who_we_support__text: Oakdene supports individuals, families, carers, and community members looking for practical help, guidance, connection, or referral support. This includes people affected by addiction, hardship, homelessness, social isolation, or other major life pressures.
who_we_support__text_2: You do not need to meet specific criteria. If you are going through a tough time and need support, we are here.

data__categories.heading: Counselling & One-on-One Support
data__categories.description: Person-centred support that helps people talk through challenges, make sense of what is happening, and identify the next step.

data__categories.heading: Group & Recovery Programs
data__categories.description: Structured group programs that build accountability, coping skills, and peer connection across the recovery journey.

data__categories.heading: Referral Pathways
data__categories.description: Help connecting with the right services when more specialised or longer-term support is needed.

data__services.title: Outpatients Program
